meta.title: Steel-Basin Whale Girl (desktop pet)
meta.description: A chibi maid whale desktop pet wearing a stainless-steel basin. Shows DeepSeek balance, bonus/top-up wallets, today's observed spend, and peak vs off-peak pricing with a 24-hour band and switch countdown. Click the basin to knock it away — the whale girl runs after it and puts it back. Click her to refresh; drag to reposition.
